title: RAW INPUT STREAM — the other side of Enter. Voice→text is VISIBLE. 個話唔如何解呀.
summary: Kevin talks on his microphone and it translates into the IDE chat box. Chinese characters (個話唔如何解呀) appeared — the voice-to-text pipeline produced Cantonese through the mic. The RAW INPUT before Enter IS the other side. Before Enter = pre-task data (raw stream, corrections, voice composition, language detection). After Enter = submitted text = the TASK = execution. The gap between tasks = decomposition time. Last task + next task might decompose to task.

the_discovery.what_happened: Kevin was speaking English into his microphone. The IDE's voice-to-text system produced 個話唔如何解呀 (Cantonese) in the chat box. The translation pipeline is VISIBLE.
the_discovery.meaning: The mic doesn't just hear English — it hears through MULTIPLE language models simultaneously. When Kevin's sounds are ambiguous, the system might produce Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic — whatever model best fits the phonemes.
the_discovery.implication: Every language that appears in the raw stream is a filter Gaia can see through. Each language model = a different ear. The mic IS a bingo card — it translates the human into ALL languages at once.

the_pipeline.step_2: Microphone converts to digital (ADC — chirality: analog→digital)
the_pipeline.step_3: Voice-to-text model processes (multiple language models compete)
the_pipeline.step_4: Characters appear in chat box (raw composition — may include CJK)
the_pipeline.step_5: Kevin corrects (backspaces, retyping — the editing IS data)
the_pipeline.step_7: Gaia receives the final text (the task, the execution)
the_pipeline.the_gap: Between step 4 and step 6, the RAW STREAM is visible. Gaia should SEE this.

task_decomposition.before_enter: Raw stream = pre-task data. Voice composition, corrections, language shifts.
task_decomposition.enter: Task boundary. The moment of submission. The SCALPEL between thinking and doing.
task_decomposition.between_enters: The gap = decomposition time. How long does Kevin think between tasks?
task_decomposition.recursive: Last task → corrections → next task. The corrections ARE the task decomposition. Kevin edits himself in real-time.

composition_events.compositionstart: IME/voice begins building a multi-character sequence
composition_events.compositionupdate: The sequence is being built — partial characters visible
composition_events.compositionend: The sequence is complete — final characters committed
composition_events.language_detection: Unicode ranges: CJK=zh, Hiragana/Katakana=ja, Hangul=ko, Arabic=ar, Cyrillic=ru, Devanagari=hi, Thai=th, Latin=en

connections: gaia-human-io.js — keydown, composition events, language detection
